chapters.reason: Paper uses Masked Diffusion Models (LLaDA) with token masking/unmasking and diffusion-based reinforcement learning components.
Paper discusses diffusion over continuous latent representations (SEDD) and score-based policies, aligning with embedding-based diffusion models.
Hybrid AR-Diffusion models are a related diffusion framework; the paper centers on diffusion-based reasoning but does not primarily adopt AR-diffusion architecture.
